paragraphs: I'm applying for the Investor Relations Analyst role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I used Salesforce data as a user in my campaign and analytics work, and I'd like to help tell the company's financial story to the people who own it.

In my MBA coursework I analyzed financial statements and disclosures to judge earnings quality across peers, and valued J.M. Smucker with comps and a DCF checked against a sell-side model. At JPMorgan I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing deployment options and prepared executive briefs for senior leadership on where to allocate budget.
IR work means knowing the numbers cold, tracking how the market sees the company and turning analysis into clear messages. That matches how I like to work. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
